title: [v0.92.1][AWS-A] AWS resource ownership inventory
body:
## Outcome

Produce one accepted all-region AWS resource ownership inventory.

## Primary deliverable

One accepted AWS resource inventory with an owner and lifecycle disposition for every discovered resource.

## Verification result

Read-only account, region, service, state-backend, tag, billing, and retained-evidence censuses reconcile without an unclassified omission.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one accepted ownership inventory; discovery probes are evidence inputs and no resource mutation is performed.

## Dependencies

- None.

## Retained predecessor scope

- None; this is new v0.92.1 work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The approved business account and regions are exact
- [ ] Every discovered resource has an owner or frozen-unknown disposition
- [ ] Website Terraform and issue evidence remain separately classified
- [ ] EBS and other retained assets are not inferred disposable

## Owned paths

- `docs/operations/cloud/aws/inventory/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/cloud/aws-a/**`

## PVF lanes

- `account-identity`
- `all-region-inventory`
- `ownership-denominator`
- `state-owner-census`
- `redaction`

## Stop conditions

- Account or region is ambiguous
- A resource owner cannot be classified
- Discovery would require mutation

## Non-goals

- Resource import
- Cleanup
- Terraform apply
